name: Plate Armor of Etherealness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Etherealness
powers.text: Magic action: cast Etherealness (once per dawn); it lasts 10 minutes.

summary: Once a day, a Magic action casts Etherealness from it (10 minutes).
text: While you're wearing this armor, you can take a Magic action to cast Etherealness from it. The spell lasts for 10 minutes, until you remove the armor, or until you take a Magic action to end it. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
